name: 陳盈竹
objective:
* 全英語授課
EMI Course: All class material will be delivered in English. All submitted works and presentation shall be in English as well.
Base on introduction to aesthetics.  By daily observation of our surroundings and environment, students are asked to take a closer look to our living world.  Class will focus on case studies of aesthetic application and renovation on various design fields.  The goal of the class is to develop the daily behavior to living environment attention and eventually promoting aesthetic standards in every profession. 
Class will include individual presentation and group discussion.
In class exercise/ discussion/ quizzes counts major part of the grades.
全英語授課: 授課/作業/簡報均需以英語呈現。
以美學入門為基礎，觀察日常生活美學的可能，進而達到提升美學的培養。
課程將著重於各個產業別對於” 美 “的建構，探討各面向” 美 “的改造及創新等。以大眾美學為觀察目標進而達到在各專業裡推廣” 美 “的最終目的。
課程進度(1-16週):
01 introduction/ 課程簡介
02 Art/ 藝術 I
03 Art/ 藝術 II
04 Visual Communication I/ 視覺傳達 I
05 Visual Communication II/ 視覺傳達 II
06 Product I/ 工業與產品設計 I
07 Product II/ 工業與產品設計 II
08 Mid-term Presentation I/ 期中簡報
09 Mid-term Presentation II/ 期中簡報與檢討
10 Architecture/ 建築 I
11 Architecture/ 建築 II
12 Landscape/ 地景與景觀
13 Urban/ 城市
14 Lifestyle/ 生活與其他
15 Conclusion/ 結語
16 Exam/ 測驗
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
